resources.string: These folders open the original Secure Folder files. Changes are shared across profiles.
Unlock your phone and Secure Folder, then turn on the connection.
Checking access and connecting your folders.
Disconnected because the phone or Secure Folder locked. Unlock both to reconnect.
Check root access and the lock state. Details are shown below.
Prevent changes and deletions through the connected folders.
Add the same folder to work storage. Locking or pausing that profile disconnects its folder separately.
The connection closes when the screen turns off, the phone or Secure Folder locks, or the controller stops. It never unlocks either profile automatically.
Only shared files are connected. Private app data is excluded. Disconnecting does not erase files already opened or copies and thumbnails saved by other apps.
Root is available. The phone and Secure Folder are unlocked.
Unlock the phone and Secure Folder before connecting.
Apps with shared-storage access on the main profile will be able to see these files.
Apps with shared-storage access on the main and work profiles will be able to see these files.
Edits, moves, and deletions affect the original Secure Folder files.

Root is required. The current Galaxy layout uses main user 0, work user 10, and Secure Folder user 150.
After startup, wait for the phone and Secure Folder to unlock, then connect once. A notification is shown while waiting. Root must already be allowed.
